Notes:
This is the audience recording made on the famous opening night in Melbourne and which is different from the 2007 soundboard which keeps getting mistaken for it. (No soundboard exists so far of the opening night!)
Anthony Warlow and much of the cast were down with flu and you can clearly hear Anthony struggling vocally at times (he conserves his voice and sings “long to BE” an octave lower in MOTN). Regardless, he and the cast give a fantastic performance and the audience have a great time as well. It’s certainly one of the best audience recordings I’ve heard from the 2007-2009 run. Also includes the announcement at the beginning where Arthur Masella tells the audience that most of the company are ill but still performing.

Notes: Final performance! Filmed in 16:9 widescreen. Few obstructions, only in the wide-shots when there are two heads on either side of the frame, but filmer does his/her best to shoot around them. This was a gut-wrenchingly sad performance. Most of the cast members were in tears at some point or another during the show.
